title: Raw proper forget-supports compositor with explicit composite properness
statement: For proper p and f and an explicit properness instance for p;f, the raw canonical-composite forget-supports compositor calculation holds.

source.place: First supported coordinate extraction: identify the properness instance for the canonical composite in the raw compositor calculation

proof.text: Apply the raw canonical-composite forget-supports compositor calculation and identify its inferred composite properness instance with the explicit instance by proof irrelevance.

proof_origin.place: First triangle, raw compositor calculation with explicit composite properness
proof_origin.why: The canonical target has an explicit IsProper (p ≫ f) instance, while the raw node infers it; this statement isolates that instance-alignment step.

lean.statement: theorem properShriekComp_comp_forgetSupports_raw_with_comp {W X S : Scheme.{u}} (p : W ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper p] [IsProper f] [IsProper (p ≫ f)] (E : DerivedCategoryModule A W) : (rightDerivedLowerShriekCompIso A p f).inv.app E ≫ (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (p ≫ f)).hom.app E = (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).map ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).hom.app E) ≫ (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom.app ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj E) ≫ (rightDerivedLowerStarCompIsoOfComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p f (p ≫ f) rfl).hom.app E
